title: Can Global XAI Methods Reveal Injected Bias in LLMs? SHAP vs Rule Extraction vs RuleSHAP
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical development and benchmarking of XAI methods (specifically RuleSHAP) to detect cognitive and injected biases in Large Language Models. While it mentions societal goals (SDGs) and references prior work on the moral beliefs encoded in LLMs, its own experimental framework does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, theology, or specific ethical systems.
